verdict.rationale: QuickBooks documents core reconciliation building blocks (auto-matching of bank transactions, discrepancy/missing-checks reports, reconciliation reports) and an 'Intuit Intelligence' chat that can 'help resolve anomalies,' plus an official MCP server exposing 145 QBO API tools that could let an agent orchestrate transaction matching and report generation. However, there's no evidence of a turnkey agentic workflow that autonomously performs an end-to-end month-end close, flags exceptions, and stages it for human review — it's largely manual/rule-based reconciliation with AI assist for isolated tasks. Missing for 10: documented end-to-end automated close/reconciliation agent workflow, evidence of exception-flagging logic beyond static reports, and independent confirmation the MCP server or Intuit Intelligence can chain these steps autonomously.
